extName.message: Padlock – Mai Samar da Kalmar Sirri Mai Tsaro

extDescription.message: Ƙirƙiri ƙaƙƙarfan kalmomin sirri na bazuwar da na'urar samar da lambobin bazuwar mai tsaro ta burauza. Komai yana nan a na'urarka.

tagline.message: Mai samar da kalmar sirri mai tsaro

historyButtonTitle.message: Nuna kalmomin sirri $COUNT$ na ƙarshe da aka ƙirƙira

avoidLookalikes.message: Guji haruffa masu kama da juna

clipboardClearLabel.message: Share allon kwafi bayan an kwafa

clipboardNever.message: Ba za a taɓa yi ba

keepHistoryLabel.message: Ajiye tarihin kalmomin sirri $COUNT$ na ƙarshe

keepHistoryHint.message: Ana ajiye kalmomin sirri ba tare da ɓoyewa ba a cikin ƙwaƙwalwar burauza kawai, kuma ana share su idan an rufe Chrome. Kashe wannan zaɓi yana share tarihin.

footer.message: Ana ƙirƙirar kalmomin sirri a cikin na'urarka da CSPRNG na burauza. Ba a aika komai zuwa ko'ina. Danna dama a filin rubutu don saka kalmar sirri.

statusCopyFailed.message: Kwafa ya gaza. Zaɓi kalmar sirri ka kwafa da hannu.

statusCopiedNoPermission.message: An kwafa. Sharewa ta atomatik tana buƙatar izinin allon kwafi; sake zaɓar zaɓin don ba da izini.

statusCopiedClearIn.message: An kwafa. Za a share allon kwafi cikin daƙiƙa $SECONDS$.

statusScheduleFailed.message: An kwafa, amma an kasa tsara sharewar allon kwafi.

statusClipboardPermissionRequired.message: Ana buƙatar izinin allon kwafi don share shi ta atomatik.

statusSaveFailed.message: Ba a iya adana saituna ba.

errorGeneric.message: Ba a iya ƙirƙirar kalmar sirri ba.

errorInvalidLength.message: Tsawo dole ya kasance tsakanin $MIN$ da $MAX$.

errorLengthTooShort.message: Tsawon bai kai yawan nau'ikan haruffan da aka zaɓa ba.

contextMenuLabel.message: Nuna “$ITEM$” a menu na danna dama

maskPasswordsLabel.message: Rufe kalmomin sirri sai an kai maɓallin linzamin kansu

settingsReset.message: An mayar da saituna zuwa na asali.

aboutPrivacy.message: Komai yana gudana a na'urarka. Padlock ba ya tattara bayanai kuma ba ya aika komai zuwa ko'ina.

checkerInputLabel.message: Rubuta ko liƙa kalmar sirri don a gwada

crackOnlineSlow.message: Harin kan layi, da iyaka ($RATE$ yunƙuri a awa ɗaya)

crackOnlineFast.message: Harin kan layi, ba iyaka ($RATE$ yunƙuri a daƙiƙa ɗaya)

crackOfflineSlow.message: Harin ba kan layi ba, hash mai jinkiri kamar bcrypt ($RATE$ yunƙuri a daƙiƙa ɗaya)

crackOfflineFast.message: Harin ba kan layi ba, hash mai sauri a GPU ($RATE$ yunƙuri a daƙiƙa ɗaya)

crackBeyondUniverse.message: Ya fi shekarun sararin samaniya tsawo

checkWarnCommon.message: Wannan na ɗaya daga cikin kalmomin sirri da aka fi amfani da su.

checkWarnPattern.message: Maimaitawa, jerin haruffa, tsarin madannai da shekaru suna da sauƙin hasashe.

checkerNote.message: Ana bincike a na'urarka kuma ba a taɓa adana ko aika kalmar sirri ba. Sakamakon kimantawa ne bisa tsawo, nau'ikan haruffa da tsare-tsare na gama-gari; ba ya iya sanin ko kalmar sirri ta fita ko an gina ta da kalmomi na yau da kullum. Lokutan matsakaici ne.
